session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Bear Spike and Channel to Midday Reversal then Trading Range'. After a gap down a climactic bear spike reaches the 2R measured move; triple top failure and a 42-bar EMA gap bear channel grind the market to 7555 where an overshoot exhaustion final leg forms the low. Midday bull wedge and multiple double bottoms reverse the market up to 7588, but the trending range rolls over and the close sells back to 7562.
